sec: CMV and MAC disease, and the antiretroviral drug classes

items.q: How is the fundus appearance of CMV retinitis described?
What average CD4 count at diagnosis is printed for MAC disease?
MAC presentation — match — 1) Constitutional 2) Nodes 3) Chest … A) Fever, night sweats and weight loss B) Pulmonary involvement is rare C) Lymphadenopathy
items.exp: 'Highly disseminated disease with : Fever, Night sweats, weight loss, Lymphadenopathy' and '· Pulmonary involvement is rare'. (Book p1067)

items.q: Which drug combination is printed for treatment of MAC?
At what CD4 count is MAC prophylaxis printed, and with which drug?
What is the treatment principle printed at the top of the treatment section?
opts: Treat only when CD4 falls below 350
Treat only if the viral load exceeds 1 lakh

items.q: Entry and entry-adjacent inhibitors — match the class to the drug — 1) CD4 receptor inhibitor 2) Co-receptor inhibitor 3) Fusion inhibitor … A) Maraviroc (oral) B) Enfuvirtide (s/c) C) Ibalizumab (IV)
items.exp: 'CD4 receptor inhibitors : Ibalizumab (IV); Coreceptor inhibitors : maraviroc (oral); Fusion inhibitors : Enfuvirtide (s/c)'. (Book p1067)

items.q: Enzyme inhibitors — match the class to the drugs — 1) Integrase inhibitors 2) Protease inhibitors … A) Ritonavir, nelfinavir, atazanavir B) Dolutegravir, raltegravir
items.exp: 'Integrase inhibitors : Dolutegravir, Raltegravir'; 'Protease inhibitors : Ritonavir, Nelfinavir, Atazanavir'. (Book p1067)

items.q: Reverse-transcriptase inhibitors — match the subclass to the drugs — 1) NRTI 2) NNRTI 3) Nucleotide RTI … A) Nevirapine, efavirenz, delavirdine B) Tenofovir disoproxil C) Abacavir, lamivudine, emtricitabine
items.exp: '1. Nucleoside reverse transcriptase inhibitors/NRTI : Abacavir, Lamivudine, Emtricitabine; 2. Non-nucleoside reverse transcriptase inhibitors/NNRTI : Nevirapine, Efavirenz, Delavirdine; 3. Nucleotide reverse transcriptase inhibitors : Tenofovir, Disoproxil'. (Book p1067)

items.q: Which drug is printed as a co-receptor inhibitor?
Which fusion inhibitor and route are printed?
Which drug is NOT printed among the protease inhibitors?
items.exp: Dolutegravir is an integrase inhibitor; the protease inhibitors listed are ritonavir, nelfinavir and atazanavir. (Book p1067)

items.q: A patient with advanced HIV has fever, night sweats, weight loss, lymphadenopathy and a CD4 count under 10. Which diagnosis, treatment and prophylaxis does the page print?
opts: Disseminated MAC — treat with clarithromycin plus ethambutol; prophylaxis with azithromycin once CD4 is below 50
Cryptococcal meningitis — treat with amphotericin B
items.exp: 'MAC : · Average CD4 at diagnosis : <10 … · Treatment : Clarithromycin + Ethambutol · Prophylaxis (CD4 <50) : Azithromycin'. (Book p1067)
